common.copy_failed: Couldn’t copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

errors.offline: No internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
errors.signed_out: Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: {date}. Here is what needs you and how sales are going.
overview.load_failed: Some numbers could not be loaded. They are shown as a dash. Try again in a moment.

todo.title: Needs your attention
todo.subtitle: Most urgent first. Each button takes you to the right place.
todo.clear_body: No orders, chats or stock need you right now.

review.one: 1 cancelled order received a payment. Check it and contact the customer.
review.other: {count} cancelled orders received a payment. Check them and contact the customers.

bank.one: 1 bank transfer to check in your bank account
bank.other: {count} bank transfers to check in your bank account

todo.bot_off: The chat assistant is off, so customers get no automatic replies.

stats.no_compare: No sales the 7 days before to compare
stats.delivering_hint: Orders on their way to customers

recent.title: Latest orders
recent.empty_body: New orders will appear here with their payment and delivery details.

chart.title: Sales, last 14 days
chart.rule: Counts paid orders by the day they were placed. Cash-on-delivery orders count once delivered. Cancelled and refunded orders are not counted.
chart.bars_label: Sales for each of the last 14 days

stock.title: Stock to watch
stock.none: All counted stock looks fine. Products whose stock you don’t count are not checked.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Newest first. Select an order to see its details and what to do next.
orders.search: Search by order number, name or phone

search.title: No order matches your search
search.body: Check the order number or phone, or clear the search.

all.title: No orders yet
all.body: When customers order, their orders appear here.

awaiting_payment.title: No orders waiting for payment
awaiting_payment.body: Orders appear here until the customer has paid.

to_ship.title: Nothing to ship
to_ship.body: Paid and cash-on-delivery orders appear here when they are ready to send.

delivering.title: Nothing out for delivery
delivering.body: Orders you send for delivery appear here until they are delivered.

cancelled.title: No cancelled orders
cancelled.body: Orders that were cancelled, or not paid in time, appear here.

next.PENDING: Check the order and confirm it to start.
next.WAITING_BANK: The customer pays by bank transfer. When {amount} is in your bank account, press “Mark as paid”. Unpaid bank-transfer orders are cancelled after 24 hours.
next.WAITING_QPAY: Waiting for the customer to pay with QPay. This updates by itself; nothing to do. Unpaid QPay orders are cancelled after 15 minutes.
next.WAITING_OTHER: Waiting for the card payment to be confirmed.
next.COD_PENDING: Pack the items and send them. The customer pays {amount} in cash on delivery.
next.PAID: Paid. Pack the items and send them.
next.DELIVERING: On the way. When the customer has it, mark it as delivered.
next.DELIVERING_COD: On the way. Collect {amount} in cash, then mark it as delivered.
next.REVIEW: Money arrived for this cancelled order. Check the payment and contact the customer about a refund or a new order.

payment_help.QPAY: QPay confirms payments by itself. A QPay order can’t be marked as paid by hand.
payment_help.BANK: The customer transfers the money to your bank account. Check your bank app before marking the order as paid.
payment_help.COD: The customer pays the courier in cash. It counts as a sale once it is delivered.
payment_help.LEMON: Card payment from an older order, confirmed by the card provider.
payment_help.UNKNOWN: No payment method was recorded for this order.

drawer.title: Order #{order}
drawer.courier_copied: Delivery details copied. Paste them to your courier.

review.title: Check this payment
review.body: This order was cancelled, but the customer’s payment arrived. Confirm the receipt, then contact the customer to refund it or place the order again.

confirm_bank.title: Has the money arrived?
confirm_bank.body: Check your bank account for {amount} for order #{order}. Only mark it as paid when the money is there.

cancel.hint: Use this if the customer changed their mind or won’t pay. The items go back into stock.
cancel.title: Cancel order #{order}?
cancel.body: The items go back into stock, and customers with an account are emailed. You can’t undo this.

done.PAID: Payment recorded for #{order}. It is ready to ship.
done.CANCELLED: #{order} cancelled. The items went back into stock.

DELIVERING.body: {orders} will move to “Out for delivery”, and customers with an account are emailed. Selected orders that aren’t ready to ship are left as they are.

DELIVERED.body: {orders} will move to “Delivered”, and customers with an account are emailed. Cash-on-delivery orders then count as paid.

bulk_failed.one: 1 order couldn’t be updated: {orders}. Refresh and try again.
bulk_failed.other: {count} orders couldn’t be updated: {orders}. Refresh and try again.

errors.changed: This order changed in the meantime. It has been refreshed; check it and try again.
errors.not_allowed: This step isn’t possible for this order any more. Refresh to see its current status.
errors.update_failed: Couldn’t update the order. Try again.

products.title: Products
products.featured_hint: Featured products are shown first on the home page.

empty.title: No products yet
empty.body: Add your first product with a photo, price and stock. It appears in the shop as soon as you save.

no_match.title: No products match
no_match.body: Try another search, or clear the filters.

toast.featured: {name} is now featured on the home page.

bulk.move_body: Choose the category they should belong to.
bulk.delete_body: They are removed from the shop for good. Products that customers have already ordered can’t be deleted; set their stock to 0 instead.

failed_ordered.one: 1 product wasn’t deleted because it has been ordered before: {names}. Set its stock to 0 instead.
failed_ordered.other: {count} products weren’t deleted because they have been ordered before: {names}. Set their stock to 0 instead.

errors.update_failed: Couldn’t save that change. Try again.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Group products so customers can find them. Changes show in the shop straight away.
categories.name: Category name
categories.empty_body: Add one above, for example “Pencils” or “Brow care”.

delete_products.one: Its 1 product stays in the shop but will have no category.
delete_products.other: Its {count} products stay in the shop but will have no category.

categories.delete_empty: No products are in this category.

delete_children.one: Its subcategory moves up to the top level.
delete_children.other: Its {count} subcategories move up to the top level.

toast.add_failed: Couldn’t add the category. Try again.
toast.rename_failed: Couldn’t rename the category. Try again.
toast.delete_failed: Couldn’t delete the category. Try again.

editor.new_hint: Fill in the details and save. It appears in the shop straight away.
editor.photos_hint: The first photo is the cover shown in the shop.
editor.video_hint: MP4, up to 4 MB. Shown on the product page.
editor.name: Name
editor.description_placeholder: What it is and how to use it…
editor.old_price_hint: Fill this in to show the product as on sale.
editor.sale_preview: Shown in the shop as −{pct}% off.
editor.sizes_hint: Leave this empty if the product comes in one version only.
editor.size_price_hint: If an option costs something else, type its price. Leave it empty to use the main price.
editor.stock_hint: Stock: 0 means sold out; leave it empty if you don’t count it. To count stock for a product without options, add one option such as “Standard”.
editor.option_added: Option added. Check its stock, then save again.
editor.featured_hint: Featured products are shown first on the home page and in the shop.

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.body: You have changes that aren’t saved. If you close now, they are lost.

delete_confirm.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete_confirm.body: It is removed from the shop for good. If customers have ordered it before, it can’t be deleted; set its stock to 0 instead.

errors.name: Write the product name.
errors.old_price: The price before the sale must be higher than the price.
errors.stock: Stock must be a whole number (0 or more), or empty.
errors.upload: A photo or video couldn’t be uploaded. Check your connection and try again. Files over 4 MB are too big.
errors.stock_changed: Stock changed while you were editing; a customer may have just ordered. Close, open the product again and re-enter the stock.
errors.in_orders: Some options are in unfinished orders. Finish or cancel those orders before renaming or removing options, or switching stock counting on or off. Stock numbers can still be changed.
errors.category_missing: That category no longer exists. Choose another one.
errors.save_failed: Couldn’t save the product. Try again.
errors.create_failed: Couldn’t add the product. Try again.
errors.delete_ordered: This product has been ordered before, so it can’t be deleted. Set its stock to 0 to stop selling it.
errors.delete_failed: Couldn’t delete the product. Try again.

revenue.title: Sales
revenue.description: Money from paid orders. Cash-on-delivery orders count once they are delivered.

trend.no_compare: No sales the period before to compare

empty.title: No sales in this period
empty.body: Sales appear here day by day once orders are paid.

rule.title: What counts as a sale?
rule.body: Orders paid by QPay or bank transfer, and cash-on-delivery orders once delivered. Unpaid, cancelled and refunded orders are not counted. Each sale belongs to the day the order was placed, in Ulaanbaatar time.

recent.title: Latest paid orders
recent.description: Select one to open the order.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: Customer messages from your website, Messenger and Instagram, and requests to call back.

bot_off.title: The chat assistant is off
bot_off.body: Customers’ messages still arrive here, but nobody replies until you do.

chat.search_label: Search the chats on this page
chat.page_note: Filters and search cover the chats on this page.

empty.none_hint: Chats from your website, Messenger and Instagram appear here.
empty.no_match_hint: Try another search or show all chats.
empty.all_done: Nobody is waiting for you right now.

thread.choose_hint: Select a chat on the left to read it and reply.
thread.empty: No messages in this chat yet.
thread.bot_handles: The assistant is replying in this chat
thread.bot_off: The assistant is off; only you can reply
thread.you_handle: You are replying; the assistant is paused in this chat

chat.composer_hint: Sending a reply pauses the assistant in this chat, so you can talk to the customer yourself. Ctrl + Enter also sends.
chat.composer_hint_paused: The assistant stays quiet here until you press “Let the assistant reply”. Ctrl + Enter also sends.

meta_off.title: Replies to {channel} are switched off
meta_off.body: Your reply is saved here, but the customer won’t receive it until you turn on sending to Messenger and Instagram.

chat.offline: You are offline. Reconnect to receive and send messages.

toast.saved_not_sent: Reply saved, but not sent: sending to Messenger and Instagram is off.
toast.taken_over: You’re replying now. The assistant won’t answer in this chat.
toast.given_back: The assistant will answer this chat again.

errors.reply_failed: Couldn’t send your reply. It is kept; try sending it again.
errors.takeover_failed: Couldn’t change who replies in this chat. Try again.

requests.page_note: Filters cover the requests on this page.

empty.none_hint: When a customer leaves a name or phone with the assistant, the request appears here with a link to the chat.

errors.update_failed: Couldn’t change the request. Try again.

assistant.title: Chat assistant
assistant.description: The assistant answers customers on your website, Messenger and Instagram. Choose what it says and how it behaves.
assistant.contact_shown: When the assistant can’t help, it gives customers these contact details:
assistant.facts_rule: Prices, stock and product facts come from your product list, so they are always right. Don’t write prices, percentages or promised results in the texts below; the save is refused if you do.

sections.behaviour_hint: These switches take effect when you save.
sections.greeting_hint: The first message a customer sees in a new chat.
sections.handoff_hint: Sent when a customer asks for a person or the assistant can’t answer.
sections.knowledge_hint: Shop facts the assistant may use, such as opening hours or delivery days.

fields.metaOutbound_hint: When off, nothing is sent to Messenger or Instagram, not even your own replies from the Chat page. The website chat keeps working.
fields.showExactStock: Show exact stock numbers to customers
fields.showExactStock_hint: When off, customers see “In stock” or “Almost gone” instead of a number, in the shop and in chat.
fields.lowStockThreshold_hint: Products with this many or fewer left are shown as “Almost gone” and appear in your stock alerts.

toast.turned_on: The assistant is on. It replies to customers again.
toast.turned_off: The assistant is off. New messages wait for you in Chat.
toast.switch_failed: Couldn’t switch the assistant. Try again.

errors.fix: Fix the highlighted fields, then save.
errors.facts: Remove prices (₮), percentages and promised results. Product facts come from your product list.
errors.threshold: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1000.
errors.save_failed: Couldn’t save the settings. Try again.

test.title: Try the assistant
test.hint: Ask a question as a customer would. Test chats aren’t shown to customers, counted in reports or sent as alerts.
test.empty_body: For example: “How long does delivery take?” or “Do you have a brown pencil?”
test.paused: The assistant didn’t reply: it is switched off or this chat was handed to a person. Start over to try again.

errors.send_failed: Couldn’t get an answer. Try again.

activity.hint: Real customer chats only; test chats aren’t counted. Requests per day cover the last 14 days.

stats.waiting_hint: Asked for a person, nobody has taken the chat yet
stats.handled_hint: Chats where the assistant is paused
stats.requests_hint: Names and phones left with the assistant

activity.no_activity: No requests in the last 14 days
activity.no_activity_hint: Requests appear here as customers leave their contact details.

log.intro: A technical record of the assistant’s errors and warnings, kept for {days} days. You usually don’t need it; it helps find out why a reply failed.
log.search: Search by event, message or request ID…
log.by_kind_hint: The most frequent first. Select one to show only that kind.
log.empty_body: No entries for this period and filter.

recent_hint.one: The latest entry. Select it for details.
recent_hint.other: The latest {count} entries. Select one for details.

log.not_configured: The log can’t be kept because the database isn’t connected.

errors.load_failed: Couldn’t load the log. Try again.

auth.login_subtitle: Sign in to manage your shop.

errors.wrong: The email or password is wrong. Check them and try again.
errors.not_admin: This account can’t open the admin. Sign in with the shop owner’s account.
errors.too_many: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
errors.google: Google sign-in didn’t work. Try again, or sign in with your email and password.
errors.generic: Couldn’t sign in. Try again in a moment.

forgot_page.title: Reset your password
forgot_page.body: Enter your account email. We’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot_page.sent_body: If {email} has an account, a reset link is on its way. It works for a limited time.
forgot_page.error: Couldn’t send the link. Try again.

reset_page.title: Choose a new password
reset_page.too_short: The password must have at least {min} characters.
reset_page.done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
reset_page.expired: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
